INPUT.name: INPUT
INPUT.desc: Flow origin. Starts the next pulse once the previous one has resolved.

OUTPUT.name: OUTPUT
OUTPUT.desc: Converts the assembled flow into a real effect. A flow with no attack form produces no attack.

WIRE.name: WIRE
WIRE.desc: Carries the flow straight through. Costs one tick.

BEND.name: BEND
BEND.desc: Turns the flow ninety degrees. Costs one tick.

PROJECTILE.name: PROJECTILE
PROJECTILE.desc: Fires a bolt along the aim direction. The standard ranged form.

SLASH.name: SLASH
SLASH.desc: An instant short arc at the aim direction. Fast, but reach is short.

AREA.name: AREA
AREA.desc: Damages everything inside a burst radius. Uses two board cells.

DASHSLASH.name: DASHSLASH
DASHSLASH.desc: Lunges along the aim direction, cutting everything on the path. Uses two cells.

DASHSLASH_AUTO.name: DASHSLASH+
DASHSLASH_AUTO.desc: Seeks the nearest visible enemy and blinks through it, cutting the path. Uses two cells.

FIRE.name: FIRE
FIRE.desc: Adds flame. Struck enemies burn for damage over time.

ICE.name: ICE
ICE.desc: Adds frost. Struck enemies are slowed.

DAMAGE.name: DAMAGE +
DAMAGE.desc: Raises damage. Stable and simple, but interacts with little else.

SIZE.name: SIZE x
SIZE.desc: Scales the attack by 1.6. Melee arcs widen and reach further.

SPEED.name: SPEED x
SPEED.desc: Bolts leave 1.5x faster. They also carry further before they fade, and are harder to dodge. Does nothing to a flow with no bolt in it.

SHATTER.name: SHATTER
SHATTER.desc: Hits an enemy already slowed by frost far harder. Worth nothing on its own — pair it with ICE, or with a board that lands twice.

PIERCE.name: PIERCE
PIERCE.desc: The attack continues through targets instead of stopping on the first.

DASH.name: DASH
DASH.desc: Lunges a short distance along the aim. Chains with melee forms into a moving arc.

BLINK.name: BLINK
BLINK.desc: Teleports behind the nearest visible enemy. Works alone; if nothing is in sight the flow simply continues.

HOMING.name: HOMING
HOMING.desc: Tracks the nearest enemy. Bolts curve; melee forms re-aim themselves.

REVERSE.name: REVERSE
REVERSE.desc: Flips travel direction. Bolts return to you; other forms invert in their own way.

GRAVITY.name: GRAVITY
GRAVITY.desc: The enemy struck is not knocked back but pinned, and every other enemy nearby is dragged onto it. Gathers a room into one place for whatever comes next.

MANA_DRAIN.name: MANA DRAIN
MANA_DRAIN.desc: Every enemy this attack connects with gives mana back to the caster. What pays for the next charge is landing hits, not waiting.

SPLIT.name: SPLIT
SPLIT.desc: Divides one flow into two. Each branch carries half the damage.

TEE.name: TEE
TEE.desc: Keeps the main flow and grows one branch sideways. Both carry full damage.

DUPLICATE.name: DUPLICATE x3
DUPLICATE.desc: Produces the same result three times at full damage. Generates a lot of heat.

OVERCLOCK.name: OVERCLOCK
OVERCLOCK.desc: Runs the whole board on a faster clock, at the price of a settling delay between cycles. Each one adds less speed than the last while the delay grows faster, so a few pay off and a wall of them does not.

DELAY.name: DELAY
DELAY.desc: One cell of waiting, like every other cell. Stagger a branch against another by giving it further to walk.

TIME_DILATION.name: TIME DILATION
TIME_DILATION.desc: Slows the world and the board alike. Not a speed buff — a change in the pace of the fight.

ON_HIT.name: ON HIT
ON_HIT.desc: Runs the branch flow as a payload when this skill connects.

ON_KILL.name: ON KILL
ON_KILL.desc: Runs the branch flow as a payload only when this skill kills.

ON_PARRY.name: ON PARRY
ON_PARRY.desc: Opens a brief guard window as the flow passes. Absorbing a hit there runs the branch flow.
